econ-pe-01-c3.text: William F. Shughart II (2008). Public Choice. The Concise Encyclopedia of Economics, Library of Economics and Liberty (Liberty Fund).
econ-pe-01-c3.quote: The logic of collective action explains why farmers have secured government subsidies at the expense of millions of unorganized consumers, who pay higher prices for food.
econ-pe-01-c3.claim: Concentrated beneficiaries lobby intensely. Diffuse losers don't organize at all.
